headline: Bulgaria's Defense Minister: "It Does Not Matter Whose Drones Pose a Threat to Our National Security"
summary: Bulgarian Defence Minister Dimitar Stoyanov said addressing threats to national security is the priority over identifying who is behind drones attacking commercial vessels in the Black Sea. He added that the ministry is not responsible for investigating the incidents.
why: Attacks on commercial shipping in the Black Sea affect insurance costs, freight routes and energy and grain flows through the region. Bulgaria is a NATO and EU member on the Black Sea coast.
